quotes.text: I am a native Texan and a student at RIT College. My uncle booked me and my friend a fishing charter with Captain Dan. I didn’t know what to expect since I never did anything like this before. We left the dock and headed out into Lake Ontario to set our lines. Then the action began and we were pulling huge fish one after another. I am not sure what I am going to do with the 50lbs+ of fish in my dorm room but was a great time that I will never forget. Thanks, Captain Dan for the experience. It was truly memorable!

Our group traveled up a night before our early next day outing. Had a nice evening out and about the Harbor. Great food, drinks, atmosphere. The next morning was fantastic with great weather. Poles bent immediately once the full motors geared down and in trolling mode. It was constant action. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience as Dan Captained us in his backyard. Thanks a million for the memories on the water. I can’t wait until next Spring. Two Thumbs up!

I was fortunate enough to fish with Capt. Dan on my first trip to Lake Ontario. Everything about the experience was top shelf. Capt. Dan went above and beyond to put us on fish, and at the end of three days, we had caught everything from Brown Trout, Steelhead and King Salmon. When I make it back to Lake Ontario, it will definitely be to fish with Capt. Dan again.

Traveled with my daughter, father and girlfriend to have a fishing experience of a lifetime. The fish were on from dawn until we had to go back never a dull moment. My 8 year old daughter had an amazing time and I would highly recommend for all ages. We will definitely book again soon, fish on!

Captain Dan found the fish early and found them OFTEN !! This was a tremendous experience, fished our limit, and will definitely be returning. Dan is a wealth of knowledge and made the day a lot of fun. Thanks again Double D ! See you again once the weather breaks !!!

Captain Dan put us on fish all day ! He is full of knowledge and a blast to fish with. We had a great time and will go back again next year. I have been fishing for over 50 years and been around a lot of Charters. The DD is the best !! Thanks Captain Dan !!
